display.entryTitle: Daisy Studio Disco Ball Light Mickeys

description: During the conga in Daisy's studio, a disco ball spins on the right. Mixed into the white spots of light it throws are several Mickey heads, and they fly past fast.

whereToLook.scene: Daisy's dance studio during the conga, the disco ball on the right
whereToLook.exactSpot: The reflected light spots sweeping the room. Some are Mickey shaped.

bestTip: Watch the walls and floor, not the ball.
